about: Behavioral evals for the cluau skill. Each case is a user prompt plus regex assertions on the response. kind=trigger expects Roblox-quality output (all Luau code blocks must lint with zero errors); kind=no-trigger expects the skill NOT to hijack unrelated requests. lang=mn requires a mostly-Cyrillic reply.
